g.text: FastAPI validates schema in the event loop
Add/retire worker tasks to match concurrency
Create, pause, restart, delete, play, or open folder
Claim lock checks state, then marks running
yt-dlp downloads through the profile chain
no new peak bytes within stall timeout?
item fails with a readable reason
Aggregate substreams, then commit item + job totals
Finish job only when no queued/running items remain
Each download runs in a worker thread,
so its progress hook uses its own
Session and commits on that thread.
